events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and mayhem of Woodstock. Which iconic performance still resonates with you today?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the music world lost the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Elvis tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today since we said goodbye to Elvis Presley. His legacy as the King of Rock and Roll remains unmatched.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur passed away on this day in 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac legacy
angles.copy: Twenty-nine years since we lost Tupac Shakur. His powerful lyrics and enduring influence continue to shape music today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the extraordinary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since the world lost the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix. Still inspiring guitarists everywhere.

events.title: Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969 in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road iconic
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57 today. That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde. Still rocking with The Pretenders!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, the unmistakable Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: Imagine UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was officially released in the UK on this day in 1975, to coincide with the 'Shaved Fish' compilation.

angles.name: Imagine UK anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' became a UK single. Its message of peace is as relevant now as ever.

events.title: iPod launch anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years today since Apple launched the device that changed our pockets and our playlists.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day celebration
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and over six decades of cinematic espionage.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. Imagine the music he'd be making today.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: John Cleese birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese. A true legend of British comedy.

events.title: The White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album iconic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece, still debated and adored today.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost the incomparable showman and Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years today since the passing of Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
